description: Consult the I Ching (Book of Changes) — the oldest continuously used divination text in the world, over 3,000 years old. Casts a hexagram and interprets it in the voice of a Daoist sage. Best for the dynamics of a situation — what is moving, what is stuck, the right action at the right time, change and transition. Currently FREE (limited to 30 readings per client per day).
